title: lycianthes glandulosa
intro: Lycianthes glandulosa, commonly known as Blue Potato Bush, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family, native to the tropical regions of the Americas and the Caribbean. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, reducing pain, and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lycianthes glandulosa include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lycianthes glandulosa include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
